headline: Shanti Gold International Limited approves rights issue for fund raising
sum: Shanti Gold International Limited's board approved a rights issue to raise capital, as disclosed to NSE on 30 June 2026. No transaction value, ratio or timeline disclosed in the outcome notice.
detail: The board meeting held on 30 June 2026 resulted in approval of fund raising via rights issue.
